[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I just walked off the stage after debating Brian Kemp, and I hope I made
you proud.

I went into this debate ready to share my vision for One Georgia and
expose my opponent’s dangerous, extreme record. And I was able to do just
that — because I knew this grassroots team had my back.

translate it into victory in just a few short weeks. Please, if you’re in
this fight with me for a better Georgia to the very end, will you make
your first donation to
power my campaign right now?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221017_B5_SYAJustLeftTheStage_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=13469%2E1862389%2EWRsHQm ]DONATE

Derek, across
Georgia, some are doing well but too many families are afraid of rising
costs, gun violence and the loss of our civil liberties. But we also have
hope that a better future is possible.

Because of hardworking Georgians, we have a $6 billion surplus and the
chance to do more.

We can make generational investments in education, health care, housing
and helping you make a good living — without raising taxes.

After four years of a governor who either doesn’t care or won’t help many
of us, who attacks our freedoms rather than protecting them, I am ready to
work for the people of Georgia and get the job done. It’s what the
governor is supposed to do.

It’s this simple: I’ll put more money in Georgians’ pockets, drive more

freedom to our lives.

thrive. Will you dig deep with me in the final days of this campaign?

name: Nick Rathod, Beto for Texas
subject: I’m going to be transparent with you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

Hi — it’s Nick, Beto’s
campaign manager.

Since Day One, I’ve committed to being transparent with our supporters and
donors about how we’re running this campaign. That’s why I’m emailing you
now.

With 22 days left to defeat Greg Abbott, the stakes couldn’t be higher in
Texas. So together, my team and I have decided to authorize the biggest
possible budget to fund our organizing, TV ads, radio ads, digital
outreach, in-person events, calls and texts to voters, relational
organizing, and more.

I’m proud of this decision, because I believe it’s essential to our
strategy to elect Beto. But it’s not without risk:

We have to meet EVERY goal between now and November 8th, or we’ll have to
make huge last-minute budget cuts that could hurt our campaign.

I could only make this decision because of the trust I have in Team Beto.
You and your fellow supporters have stepped up again, again, and again to
reach even our steepest goals. That’s why I’m reaching out today to see if
you will get on board and help us back Beto with the biggest possible
campaign budget.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221017-3.jTrKR8&refcode=ema20221017-213031&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=213031%2E444211%2EjERxZQ ]Will
you make your first
donation toward our campaign now? We’re aiming to raise $1,000,000 in the
next 48 hours to match our major new budget, which will only happen if
a lot of first-time donors pitch in for the first
time.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221017-3.jTrKR8&refcode=ema20221017-213031&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=213031%2E444211%2EjERxZQ ]Contribute $3

It’s as simple as this.

If we don’t meet our goals, we will reach fewer voters, host fewer events,
and even risk pulling some of our ads off the air right as voters are
casting their ballots.

But if we DO meet our goals, we will have the resources to maximize our
efforts on every front and ensure our best chance of electing Beto as
Governor on November 8th.

Believe me when I tell you that donations in the $3 to $100 range make up
the vast majority of our campaign’s funds. Folks like YOU will decide
whether or not we can execute a winning campaign over the next three
weeks.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221017-3.jTrKR8&refcode=ema20221017-213031&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=213031%2E444211%2EjERxZQ ]So I’m asking you directly: Will you please give anything you can
today? It might not feel like it, but even a few dollars will help us get
to $1,000,000 in the next 48 hours and fund our ambitious new budget.

I’m confident we’re going to come together and take Beto’s campaign to the
next level, right when it matters most.

Thank you so much,

Nick Rathod
Campaign Manager, Beto for Texas

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1022&akid=213031%2E444211%2EjERxZQ

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

We have a critical ad on crime called "SWIPE" that voters need to see, but we need the money to run it everywhere across the state. Instead of borrowing from one ad to pay for another, it's critical that we raise more money. Democrats are focused on taking me down because they cannot win discussing the issues important to Americans. They don't want voters to know that their soft-on-crime policies are ruining our country. This ad is that important, Fellow American. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Madeleine Foote, LCV
subject: ACTION ALERT: SCOTUS poised to GUT protections for clean water. We need to protect clean water now!
body:
Add your name today. |
---
| | **
DEMAND PROTECTIONS FOR OUR WATERS**
The Supreme Court recently heard arguments for a case called _Sackett v. EPA_ , which will determine if our wetlands and other waters can be protected under the Clean Water Act. If the Court sides with corporate polluters to overturn these long-standing, popular safeguards, it will jeopardize the waters our families and communities depend on.

Last year, the EPA proposed a rule to protect our waters under the Clean Water Act. By finalizing this rule and showing strong public support for it, we can send a signal to the Court that we want more protections for our streams, wetlands, lakes, rivers, and other waters -- not less! [Help us deliver 10,000 signatures to urge the Biden administration to finalize protections for our waters.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/4L4XB9d-4qB-/UmZ0VW8yR1JVbmlQQzlVRGpXTHFBNDhHQ0VjdlVLbEJEMStORmVTc1M0MHVMYmRkeXE4UVp5Uk00V3ZoZTYyQjdqSGYycTRJL0gvMVVjVFdzZUlQZ2pNamRFdFcwYzY5bmswUlBnbEREUFU9S0/VDcwSnd5M0MxaVoxcEdpTktYdmQvTUc5eVRIdzNudzZZeDBEenFsa29TMTZ1QlZxREFDWkJXVFNFSmVvLzhHQTBxMTB0UGtiUzJmS0ZJTmp5REt1UTdFQmQ4ZUhFeGgzS0)
|
---
**[**TAKE ACTION**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6feE3~VF_/UmZ0VW8yR1JVbmlQQzlVRGpXTHFBNDhHQ0VjdlVLbEJEMStORmVTc1M0MHVMYmRkeXE4UVp5Uk00V3ZoZTYyQjdqSGYycTRJL0gvMVVjVFdzZUlQZ2pNamRFdFcwYzY5bmswUlBnbEREUFU9S0/VDcwSnd5M0MxaVoxcEdpTktYdmQvTUc5eVRIdzNudzZZeDBEenFsa29TMTZ1QlZxREFDWkJXVFNFSmVvLzhHQTBxMTB0UGtiUzJmS0ZJTmp5REt1UTdFQmQ4ZUhFeGgzS0)**

** **
|
Peter --

Right now, the Supreme Court is poised to gut critical clean water safeguards as it debates _Sackett v. EPA_ , a case about which waters should be protected under the Clean Water Act. Without federal protections, corporate polluters could freely dump into our streams and destroy wetlands that protect against flooding and provide clean drinking water.

As climate change brings about more severe storms and flooding, now is when we can _least_ afford to weaken protections for our communities. Failing to protect the wetlands that mitigate storm surge and flood waters would cost lives and devastate local economies -- a price that no one should have to pay in the name of corporate profits.

What's more, the water crises in Flint, Michigan and Jackson, Mississippi make clear we need to be doing more, not less, to protect the waters our communities and families depend on to live healthy, thriving lives. If the Supreme Court does gut EPA's ability to protect our water, it will jeopardize all our health, especially the health of Indigenous communities, low-wealth communities, and communities of color who are already disproportionately burdened by water pollution. |
---
**[**TAKE ACTION TO
PROTECT OUR WATERS**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6feE3~VF_/UmZ0VW8yR1JVbmlQQzlVRGpXTHFBNDhHQ0VjdlVLbEJEMStORmVTc1M0MHVMYmRkeXE4UVp5Uk00V3ZoZTYyQjdqSGYycTRJL0gvMVVjVFdzZUlQZ2pNamRFdFcwYzY5bmswUlBnbEREUFU9S0/VDcwSnd5M0MxaVoxcEdpTktYdmQvTUc5eVRIdzNudzZZeDBEenFsa29TMTZ1QlZxREFDWkJXVFNFSmVvLzhHQTBxMTB0UGtiUzJmS0ZJTmp5REt1UTdFQmQ4ZUhFeGgzS0)**

We know that the public overwhelmingly supports robust federal protections for clean water. Decades of polling shows that people across the ideological spectrum want the federal government to do more to ensure all our waters are safe for drinking, swimming, and fishing. Polluters know this, which is why they're relying on an undemocratic and increasingly extremist Supreme Court to weaken clean water safeguards.

Last year, the Biden administration proposed a new rule to provide protections to our wetlands, streams, and other waters that are currently vulnerable to pollution and destruction. We need them to finalize this rule ahead of the Supreme Court's decision to try and dissuade the Court from gutting the Clean Water Act. And we must demonstrate to the Court that we support the EPA's authority to enact strong safeguards for our waterways to ensure that everyone, no matter their race, zip code, or income, has access to clean water.

By restricting the Clean Water Act, the Court is poised to put our families, communities, and livelihoods at risk for the benefit of big polluters. We need the Biden administration to quickly finalize this rule and help show the Court we will not let them gut clean water safeguards! [Make sure your voice is heard -- we need 10,000 environmentalists to demand action today.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/L6b_s3LKm9cq/UmZ0VW8yR1JVbmlQQzlVRGpXTHFBNDhHQ0VjdlVLbEJEMStORmVTc1M0MHVMYmRkeXE4UVp5Uk00V3ZoZTYyQjdqSGYycTRJL0gvMVVjVFdzZUlQZ2pNamRFdFcwYzY5bmswUlBnbEREUFU9S0/VDcwSnd5M0MxaVoxcEdpTktYdmQvTUc5eVRIdzNudzZZeDBEenFsa29TMTZ1QlZxREFDWkJXVFNFSmVvLzhHQTBxMTB0UGtiUzJmS0ZJTmp5REt1UTdFQmQ4ZUhFeGgzS0)

Thank you for supporting clean water and healthy communities. I'm grateful to be by your side in this fight.

Onward,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director
League of Conservation Voters

body:

_Good morning! __I stumbled across this candid in-depth breakdown of our race, our odds and why we 're just days from winning Oregon's Governorship for the first time in forty years! I figured you'd find it interesting too! **Give it a read, and I think you 'll agree that if we don't ****[_secure our lead_](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-r/)****, we might just wake up to 'Governor-elect Tina Kotek' in twenty-two days.**_ [DONATE $5 TO 🔒 SECURE OUR VICTORY](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-j/) ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ [](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-t/) No state voting for governor this year has seen a longer Republican drought than Oregon. In 1982, Republican Gov. Vic Atiyeh _**[handily won reelection](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-i/)**_ , but since then Democrats have come out on top in 10 consecutive gubernatorial elections, allowing them to govern Oregon for nearly four decades.But 2022 might be the year Republicans finally break their Beaver State losing streak. Republican Christine Drazan, the former minority leader of the Oregon House of Representatives, is running neck and neck with Democrat Tina Kotek, the former longtime speaker of the state House who could become the first out lesbian governor in the U.S. _**[FiveThirtyEight 's 2022 midterm forecast](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-d/)**_ views the race as a toss-up, giving Kotek and Drazan each about a 1-in-2 shot of victory.[2](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-h/) And Drazan holds a narrow 34 percent to 33 percent advantage over Kotek in _**[FiveThirtyEight 's polling average](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-k/)**_, with independent Betsy Johnson, a former state legislator who served for nearly two decades as a Democrat, attracting about 20 percent. [DONATE $5 TO 🔒 SECURE OUR VICTORY](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-u/) One reason Drazan has a chance is that, while Oregon leans Democratic, it's far from being a deep-blue state. For instance, George W. Bush nearly won the state _**[in the 2000 presidential race](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-o/)**_ , and in 2016, Oregon elected Republican Dennis Richardson as secretary of state, making him the first GOP candidate to win a statewide race _**[since 2002](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-b/)**_. In fact, while Oregon has consistently elected Democrats to the governorship since the 1980s, the Democratic margin of victory has only once exceeded 10 percentage points, with Republicans coming closest to winning in 2010, when they lost by just 1.5 points.Still, even very favorable Republican midterm years like 2010 haven't been good enough for the GOP to capture the _**[governor 's mansion in Salem](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-n/)**_, so what explains Drazan's heightened chance of success? At least three factors seem to be playing a part: Johnson's role as a major independent candidate, Kotek's poor public perception and Democratic Gov. Kate Brown's unpopularity -- all of which may have many Oregonians looking for change. [DONATE $5 TO 🔒 SECURE OUR VICTORY](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-p/) Few statewide races involve a truly competitive third wheel, but Johnson could significantly impact this election. Not only is she polling well, she's also outraised Drazan and Kotek: Johnson had brought in $13.2 million in total contributions, more than Kotek's $12.7 million and Drazan's $10.7 million.[4](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-x/) And _**[Johnson has positioned](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-m/)**_ herself _**[between her opponents](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-c/)**_ , dinging Drazan for her anti-abortion stance and Kotek for allegedly intending to make Oregon "woke and broke." Johnson has received high-profile, bipartisan endorsements from former Democratic Gov. Ted Kulongoski and former Republican Sen. Gordon Smith, and major financial support from uber-wealthy Nike co-founder Phil Knight and timber industry executives (Johnson herself comes from a _**[wealthy family with timber interests](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-q/)**_).But for all the attention and money it has garnered, Johnson's candidacy is less a question about winning -- she has less than a 1-in-100 shot of winning the governorship, and FiveThirtyEight only recently made her a viable candidate in our forecast -- and more a question of whether she boosts either candidate's chances by siphoning off more Democrats or Republicans. Emerson College _**[released a poll on Tuesday](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-a/)**_ that found Drazan a smidge ahead of Kotek, with both in the mid-30s, and Johnson trailing at 19 percent. But Johnson earned more support among Democrats (17 percent) than Republicans (9 percent). Additionally, the poll found Kotek winning only 59 percent of self-identified Biden voters, with Johnson carrying 27 percent of them, while Drazan was winning 79 percent of Trump voters and Johnson just 9 percent. Similarly, _**[a late September poll](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-f/)**_ by DHM Research on behalf of The Oregonian/OregonLive also put Drazan and Kotek both in the low 30s, with Johnson at 18 percent, and that poll also found more Democrats (19 percent) than Republicans (13 percent) planned to vote for Johnson.This is not to say Drazan's path to victory is all down to Johnson complicating Kotek's efforts to consolidate the Democratic base, as the public sees Kotek more negatively than it sees Drazan. The Emerson poll found, for example, that only 38 percent of likely voters viewed Kotek favorably, while 50 percent viewed her unfavorably, including a rough 55 percent unfavorable rating among independents. By comparison, Drazan ran about even among all likely voters, at 42 percent favorable and 41 percent favorable. (Johnson had overall numbers similar to Kotek.) This may be down to Kotek's profile as a _**[strong progressive on social issues](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-z/)**_ , which may make it easier for her opponents to paint her as too left-wing for even a blue-leaning state like Oregon. At the same time, she has a reputation as a wheeler-dealer, which has at times angered members of her party; this could help explain why almost 1 in 5 Democrats also held an unfavorable view of Kotek in the Emerson poll. [DONATE $5 TO 🔒 SECURE OUR VICTORY](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-v/) Having served as speaker from 2013 to early 2022, Kotek _**[is also linked](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-e/)**_ to outgoing Democratic Gov. Kate Brown, who held the state's top job for most of the same period, after becoming governor following Democratic Gov. John Kitzhaber's _**[2015 resignation](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-s/)**_. But Brown is leaving office unpopular _**[amid complaints about](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-g/)**_ lengthy school closures because of the COVID-19 pandemic and concerns about conditions in Portland, which has suffered from vandalism, public disorder and a lack of affordable housing. In the second quarter of 2022, 55 percent of Oregon's registered voters disapproved of Brown and only 40 percent approved, according to _**[Morning Consult 's polling](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-w/)**_, so the incumbent may serve as an anchor weighing down Kotek and encouraging voters -- even Democrats and left-leaning independents - to consider their alternatives.With a month to go, Drazan is far from certain to win, but for a Republican to be in a toss-up race for Oregon governor presents the best opportunity the GOP has had _**[since 2010](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-yd/)**_ , when Republican Chris Dudley, a former NBA player, _**[narrowly lost amid that year 's red wave.](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-yh/)**_ This time around, we're _**[not really seeing](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntyhtlk-iukrjimdh-yk/)**_ the same sort of wave developing, but the dynamics of the three-way race combined with the unpopularity of Kotek and Brown may still deliver Republicans a win, ending four decades of futility. name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Banned from his own daughter's graduation
body:
| | | Friend,
Radical leftist teachers and school districts have gone too far. First, they tried shoving Critical Race Theory and transgender propaganda down our throats. Then, they began holding secret “equality clubs” and convinced children that they might be bisexual or transgender without telling their parents. Now, they’re doing everything in their power to completely silence and censor anyone who fights back. **In fact, they’re even BANNING parents from attending their own children’s graduation ceremonies if they disagree with the woke curriculum being taught.** I’m happy to announce that we’re taking legal action to fight back, but we need your help urgently. **[Which is why I’m asking for an emergency donation of $35 or more today to help the Center for American Liberty protect free speech and fight back against the venomous cancel culture that has infiltrated our schools.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhrgcr92jpmbajer4dut6h8tkh0e16nmfro4d860_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1geeoj3chh2bs)** Shawn McBreairty is the father of a high school senior in Bangor, Maine who was told that he was not allowed to attend his daughter’s graduation ceremony. Why? Because Shawn had the audacity to question the public school’s curriculum and speak out against radical school board members. You see, Shawn filed a series of public record requests (FOAA) and complaints about the conduct of school personnel.** ****However, instead of investigating the issues that Shawn was pointing out, the school district filed a lawsuit against Shawn, seeking to silence him and prevent him from ever filing FOAA requests ever again.** And on top of that, the school district informed him that he was not allowed to attend any of his daughter’s graduation events. But Shawn hasn’t given up – in fact, he’s now working with my team to take the fight to the next level. We’ve filed an Anti-SLAPP motion to dismiss the ridiculous lawsuit against Shawn—because Shawn’s speech is CLEARLY protected by the First Amendment. We’re fighting hard, but we can’t do it without you. **[Will you join the fight for to protect the rights of parents like Shawn today with a gift of $35 or more?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoct7go4ql725hdfr9qfktbip8e0hu3b5a9ued38_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1geeoj3chh2bs)** Let me take a moment to introduce myself. My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm the Founder of the Center for American Liberty and I've dedicated my career to preserving Constitutional liberties like the freedom of speech which are constantly under attack by the radical left. The Constitution clearly protects your ability to criticize public officials and government employees. It doesn’t matter if it’s the President of the United States or a school board member in your community – no one is above criticism. You and I cannot allow school districts like the Herman School Department in Bangor, Maine, to get away with censoring parents. **Enough is enough.** It’s time for all of us to stand with parents like Shawn and let these radical schools know that they will no longer be allowed to silence us or corrupt our kids. There’s no time to waste. [**So please, send your urgent gift of $35 or more today and help us defeat this ridiculous lawsuit with our Anti-SLAPP motion today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8uvpd1h4kh9hra11dqd9t6vsej1r4a0c7rnnbao_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1geeoj3chh2bs) Thank you in advance for your support. Onward to victory,

Harmeet K. Dhillon

subject: FBI raids pro-lifer's home
body:
And we're defending him!
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Fellow American, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort – which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr1eru8om4fegf7qqvsablucdq1dbh9r3tki9bg8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c1geeoj4s9h2bs) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. (ATLANTA) - Today, with three weeks to go until Election Day, Greater Georgia released a new radio ad entitled, "[Make Your Voice Heard](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_RKYL9oTe8NOD03kr3LZLKAurKiYi3Amef5OLch8zv48rzBOw7xCFezGgszDwO6ABRiA7ifJBDXzKTxKLQMlpuMKfRW-bJcBDnaDSaL7aP57MwnFeo_GqFw4HR7zSepD0fCgGBj7XkEEZTyU62KY-fgA85OKUKxJtZcUf4XhRZPX3k8x1Aq2Z9lZv7e46IyL58cPI-8azb73C5mMrLiAuA==&c=nojkekG-LkoV-jlewJqHl7nXMV7Kfw0A7ENsSOnE7c2FXOnmSiuTlw==&ch=JWSKqU7HM0xe_zjT0qmTovgKPhZZZi4XT0dLjUP4TDMzoHGf08YzfA==)." body:

Peter, the stakes have never been higher than the upcoming election.

Over the past few years, the far-Left has gone scorched earth trying to force their extreme agenda and woke ideologies onto the American people.

>From their draconian lockdowns to their indoctrination of our children as young as preschool, Leftists have made known they believe they know better than you when it comes to making decisions for yourself and your family.

This election is bigger than just claiming victory in November, Peter.

The future of Florida’s families, businesses, and children are on the line.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=a951351f8923bb4d953e22d9c600a36dd065eea7325468d73aecff8fba3e05410524fb716e251954d0e674a188d3a60aaa7225946ebfadea
HELP KEEP FLORIDA FREE

This election will decide whether you are able to run your life the way you see fit.

They will decide if you are forced to get a jab you don’t want to keep a job you need.

They will decide if you have a right to know what your child is being taught in the classroom and whether or not you have a voice to speak up when you see something wrong.

If the Left gets their way, your right to make decisions for your family as you see fit and your right to parent your children will be ripped away.

Simply put, Peter, the Left is attempting to hijack our education system and replace you in the upbringing of your children.

They believe our children are theirs to raise, to teach, and to own.

As a father of three young children, I understand personally how frightening that thought is to parents.

Radicalized bureaucrats and teachers’ unions believe they know better than parents do, and they are making it more difficult for parents as they try to raise our children for us.

This is why I’ve made known in Florida that families DO NOT co-parent with the government.

Your children are yours to raise, not some whack-job politician or woke teachers’ union.

As long as I am Governor, you can rest assured our school systems will continue to educate – not indoctrinate – our kids, but the extreme Left is fighting to make sure that doesn’t happen.

Right now, dark money is being poured into Florida in an attempt to flip our state blue.

The liberal elite want nothing more than to sink their claws into our state and control every aspect of our lives – and they’re willing to spend MILLIONS to make it happen.

I’m fighting back against their attempts to take over our state – but I can’t do it alone.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=a951351f8923bb4d953e22d9c600a36dd065eea7325468d73aecff8fba3e05410524fb716e251954d0e674a188d3a60aaa7225946ebfadea
SEND YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT TO JOIN ME IN THE FIGHT

We owe it to our kids to give everything we’ve got in the fight to Keep Florida Free.

They deserve a childhood where they are allowed to just be kids free of woke ideologies and hyper-sexualization being forced on them.

Their childhood, education, and future are on the line – but the decision is up to us.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=a951351f8923bb4d953e22d9c600a36dd065eea7325468d73aecff8fba3e05410524fb716e251954d0e674a188d3a60aaa7225946ebfadea

Friend,

Last week’s January 6 Committee hearing was full of stunning revelations about just how bad things could’ve gotten. We learned that Nancy Pelosi had to coordinate the safety of Vice President Mike Pence and that Donald Trump totally ignored his advisors when they debunked his lies about the election being stolen. None of this was normal. It shows how close we came to losing our democracy.
But as I was watching, I was struck by something: **Reps. Liz Cheney and Adam Kinzinger have so much courage.[Just listen to Kinzinger as he presented evidence during the hearing.](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VWj4dt2TfhdjW2pBcC15y3ZCnW93kvSZ4RhBTjN5g75kc3q90_V1-WJV7CgWnwW8hYnKg2FY2LvW1RfKZJ4qCbMLW6NwkZH6_q8bbN6T-nqDMSL6qW4DVz312hlbcwW3RLtHh899NF2W7kQDdZ1Qj-8gVG4NPx7dxqjWW7rTr368yLfS3N5Y2lbVdK-M-W4Hv9mL4ftJDQW71tsVm7ktlzPW2mQx1b1flHp4W7pxWJP6fR9zkW1F0wPq2D36l8W70gzlv3dSCmBW2g_LQs3_LhGqW20k8dt1j2d4JVMq_SW4b4PwmW6Nlp7M1P4kYJW72_vJh1VywPbW4078CD1DbjKcN26wtzMhf8SYW6jf67H6R4vbBW6FWlNx8B7fJWW9jQXP_5LZYlGW2k1dqj7xVXBrW6Syw5r56JqgqW30tg9K7KlDCHW6xhMMW4p_-NX3gTD1)**

It’s easy to become jaded and cynical about what has happened to the Republican Party. So many of the party’s leaders have decided to excuse the worst behavior by Trump and his allies. In spite of all the pressure, Liz and Adam refused to go along.
##
They know what it means to be courageous and love their country more than their party. **They did what was right, not just what was politically convenient.**
##
Now more than ever, they deserve to know we stand with them.

Sarah Longwell Executive Director, Republican Accountability Project

| | | | | _Cliff, here. I know, * **I KNOW** ,* you’re getting a lot of donation reminders for the Warnock campaign. Here’s why:_ _Sen. Warnock is determined to have a people-powered campaign, so that when he goes to work, the donors he’s working to represent are people like you and me. Meanwhile, the GOP is flooding Georgia with tens of millions of dollars. It takes a lot of $5, $27, and $40 donations to add up to even one million dollars, and it’s less than one percent of voters who donate. _ _And just like with voting, we may not enjoy getting reminders but the average voter needs reminders so we remember to go to the polls on a weekday when we all have a lot of other urgent things we could do instead._ _Your $5 today could help remind a Georgia voter just that one extra time they needed to get to the polls, and save our Senate majority. And if you do give to the Warnock campaign to help them get voters to the polls ... how much likelier are you to go to the polls yourself? You’ve invested._ _So here’s to leaving it all on the field on Election Day. Here’s to our shared struggle to save our country. Here’s Raphael Warnock, asking for your help to save the Senate ..._ _Peter,_ Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day, and early voting has now started in Georgia. I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, **but we have a problem:** With experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me. **[That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tec710fb7-daf0-466f-8d41-672addcaf839/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy

We’ve got a big problem — we’re talking about a **multi-million dollar problem.**

We’re just THREE WEEKS OUT from Election Day and TWO WEEKS OUT from the start of Early Voting, and the GOP’s dedicated House Super PAC, the Congressional Leadership Fund, has gone into overdrive to try to flip this seat.

**_They’re pouring MILLIONS of last-minute dark-money dollars into TV ads to try to tip the balance toward my opponent._** We can’t let them dominate the airwaves these next two weeks — right when swing voters are making their decisions.

There’s no getting around it — this is the time to fight fire with fire. We need to get our ads up and our message out as widely as possible to counter this, and we’ve gotta do it FAST. Over the long course of our shared history, the United States has lived through a number of monumental crises.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to face up to — and live up to — the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
I've spent more than four decades making films about turning points in American history in an attempt to help us understand our past and interpret our present. I know when a historic moment is upon us, and the outcome of the November election is clearly such a moment.
Now more than ever, it’s important to support leaders who unite us in defending our democracy — no matter your party affiliation. And Arizona Senator Mark Kelly has proved himself to be such a leader, a good man who has spent his life serving our country, and who will continue to honorably serve not only Arizonans but all Americans.
Plainly said, the United States Senate needs Mark Kelly. We need Mark Kelly. So, please:

An underlying principle of democracy — and it’s a very precious one — is the right for men and women to make decisions over our own bodies. And any attempt to restrict that right or put up barriers to freedom is an attempt to control us all.

subject: ESG - Woke or Broke?
body:
ESG - Woke or Broke? By John WilliamsOctober has not always been kind to the U.S. stock markets, and fear is growing amongst investors as we enter the earnings season where many large corporations | |
---

| | | ESG - Woke or Broke? |
---|---|---
| |
---
By John Williams
October has not always been kind to the U.S. stock markets, and fear is growing amongst investors as we enter the earnings season where many large corporations report their earnings for the previous year and forecast earnings for the upcoming year. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 are down 20% and 25% year-to-date, respectively. People are concerned about their investments and retirement portfolios and rightfully so!
Many Americans save for their retirement through a tax-deferred investment account such as an IRA or 401(k). Most of the time, this money is placed in various mutual fund companies, and their funds are then invested in the stocks of individual companies chosen by the asset managers of those funds. The goal for these investments is simple: invest in companies that make a profit, so your retirement assets grow as much as possible. Less profit means less money for retirement.
This might seem like common sense, but it's becoming less common thanks to a new investment strategy called ESG. If you're wondering what that means, you're not alone.
[Click Here - Contact Mississippi State Treasurer David McRae](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Campaigns/98209/Respond)
ESG stands for Environmental, Social, and Governance, and, generally, it means that a company's first concern should no longer be how much money it makes, but rather how much social good it does. In other words, "woke investing."
If you're an oil company, for example, you're out of luck because, by the nature of your business, it's assumed you're destroying the planet. Never mind that you're powering homes and hospitals. That doesn't count.
In fact, if you're a company just trying to make a profit, you're the problem. ESG proponent Klaus Schwab, chairman of the World Economic Forum, puts it this way: "We can't continue with an economic system driven by selfish values, such as short-term profit..."
People who advocate for ESG investing view Capitalism as a threat, but the genius of capitalism is that it requires businesses to do good things for society to make a profit. Think about it. If you want to start a business, you'll have to create a product or service that helps others and at a price they can afford. In a free enterprise system, you can't make money without providing a social good or service that people desire or want. Therefore, Capitalism is, by its very nature, conscientious of society.
The pursuit of profits has fueled many of mankind's greatest innovations. Everything from aspirin to airplanes came about because of the desire for profit. Profit is why you have a job, clothes, a house, food, and every other necessity. Profit isn't selfish-it motivates us to contribute our talents to help others.
ESG threatens this system by vilifying profits. ESG wants you to live in a world where profits take a backseat to income inequality, race and gender sensitivity, and climate alarmism. Companies complying with ESG requirements become less profitable at producing "widgets" because they must focus their profits on solving societal challenges.
But even if you wanted to address those concerns, how would ESG help you do it? That's a fair question because there are no ESG certifications or consistent standards. In fact, there is a LOT of discretion about who gets the label and who doesn't. Most of the time, the decisions on who gets the ESG label are decided based on political views. By comparison, in capitalism, there is a simple metric to determine success: how much profit you make.
However, there are much larger concerns when it comes to ESG. At its core, ESG is about control and is the codification of the cancel culture. It uses economic force to direct the flow of capital to force people and companies to abide by the views of one side of the political spectrum.
Today, we see this in the form of a government using the private sector to do its bidding, through a backdoor process that the government couldn't get done through the Constitution. ESG sucks the life out of a democracy because it puts a small group of Elitists and corporate boards in charge of solving societal problems that should be openly discussed and debated in the public square.
We see this manifested from two primary sources, Wall Street and Silicon Valley. From Silicon Valley we see this in the form of censorship of content, and from Wall Street we see this from large financial institutions using their economic power to force policies on Americans that they never would've accepted through the democratic process.
In 1776, we fought a revolution, not between Republicans and Democrats, but between the idea of a system of citizens engaging in self-governance versus a system of enlightened elites deciding behind closed doors what's best for society at large. ESG is the 21st century embodiment of everything we fought against in 1776 and a precursor to Marxism.
So, if somebody tries to sell you on Environmental, Social, and Governance investing, hold on tight to your wallet and your values because ESG is coming for both!

Friend,

I’m writing to you today with urgency. **We are less than 25 days away from Election Day, and we MUST Take Back the House.** _There is no other option._

Conservatives across the country are running in close races that are **CRUCIAL** victories if we want to win the House Majority. I believe the road to the majority runs through Virginia, and one district in particular: VA-07.

**Radical Socialist Abigail Spanberger** is currently representing Virginians in the 7th District. Spanberger votes with Nancy Pelosi 100% of the time, yet tells her constituents she’s a moderate. While gas prices rise, inflation worsens, and community safety is at risk, Spanberger does nothing.

| [Tell Dan Newhouse: We need REAL immigration reform – not 21st century indentured servitude.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52835882/373575955/-1498866928?refcode=DW_EM_PT_WL_221018_1_1&refcode2=48237d31-044f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=sdqJKqjEA6Mbn%2Fl3iyZ4GYfqODnR7OB0SMhntGpgKCT%2BNT6%2FRxrtfpE8OmQkGSMS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODIzN2QzMS0wNDRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cz_v_W8R9SZImlJXoBLh6Oo_dv24ZGGsPDWfTizver0=&emci=5ad723dc-fb4e-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=48237d31-044f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=7651992) | | **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52835883/373575956/-1498866928?refcode=DW_EM_PT_WL_221018_1_1&refcode2=48237d31-044f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=sdqJKqjEA6Mbn%2Fl3iyZ4GYfqODnR7OB0SMhntGpgKCT%2BNT6%2FRxrtfpE8OmQkGSMS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODIzN2QzMS0wNDRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cz_v_W8R9SZImlJXoBLh6Oo_dv24ZGGsPDWfTizver0=&emci=5ad723dc-fb4e-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=48237d31-044f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=7651992)**
---
We know immigration is vital to our communities and our economy. And we know that our current immigration system makes it too complicated and too expensive for workers to stay and work with our small farms and businesses.

**But Dan Newhouse’s so-called “Farm Workforce Modernization Act” is NOT an acceptable solution.**

This legislation dangles the promise of permanent residency and even citizenship to people who consistently work agricultural jobs for at least 8 years. That’s 8+ years of consistent, physically demanding labor – often without taking significant time off, which would risk being replaced on the job – with no real guarantee of citizenship or even permanent residency at the end of it.

Dominic Rapini, Election Reform Leader

** Don’t Miss Tonight’s Debate!
------------------------------------------------------------

Tonight, I will face off against my Democratic opponent, Stephanie Thomas at 8 p.m. for our first formal debate. The debate will be live across allCT Public platforms (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=f304c43731&e=8763c56857) , including PBS and NPR.

There will be a Debate Watch Party at West Haven RTC Headquarters—315 Morgan Lane, West Haven, CT, 1st Floor. Food and beverages will be served. My heartfelt thanks to the West Haven RTC for their assistance with this event.

Right now, there are 4 federal fraud investigations going on. In a separate case, last month there was a conviction. Yet at the press conference the Democrats hosted a few weeks ago on elections—no press member asked my opponent about the investigations and she has yet to acknowledge them. Rather, she is too focused on spreading lies and misinformation about my campaign.

I hope tonight we will concentrate on and acknowledge the issues before us. As many of you know, since the beginning of my campaign, my message has been about restoring integrity in our elections. That starts with recognizing that there are problems. But, if elected your next Secretary of the State, I know that I have the knowledge and experience to fix them and make our elections some of the best in the country.

I hope you will tune in—whether at home or by joining my team at the Watch Party.

Thank you and Godspeed,

Dominic Rapini

Peter, MAGA Republican Christine Drazan loves to talk about her so-called “roadmap” for Oregon, but what she doesn’t tell you is that her roadmap would only take our state to the right — the far-right. In Drazan’s far-right Oregon... ... abortion would be banned.

... employers could fire someone just because they're gay.

... wages would be cut and worker protections eliminated.

... climate change progress would be reversed.

... guns would be easier to buy than Plan B. **Christine Drazan** wants to take away the fundamental rights of Oregonians, and will prioritize the interests of extremist groups, billionaires, and the ultra-wealthy corporations who have bankrolled her campaign. Michelle won’t be able to win this race alone, we need you in this fight with us | | | Hey Peter, this is Jessica Cisneros. I first met Michelle Vallejo back in 2019. It was at my launch party in Hidalgo County when I decided to run for the first time. She was there from Day 1, ready to fight for the change South Texas deserves. From the very beginning I knew Michelle cared deeply about her community and was working hard to make sure our gente thrive. When she launched her campaign, I knew she was going to fight for our dreams as hard as we do. And when she won the May Runoff Election, despite being outspent 3 to 1, she proved that she has us — the pueblo — on her side. Her passion for her community and consistent ability to win elections should mean the DCCC is doing everything they can to make sure Michelle gets elected. Unfortunately, the DCCC and House Majority PAC have decided to spend close to a million dollars protecting anti-choice Henry Cuellar, who has years in office, millions of dollars in his war chest in what should not be a competitive race, instead of supporting a first time candidate and the the only progressive latina running in South Texas. Michelle's background is a quintessential South Texas story. It's powerful and has inspired a new electorate to get involved in politics because she gives them something to vote for. This is the kind of energy we should be embracing, not abandoning. If Cuellar wins and Michelle loses in November, mark my words: the establishment will try to paint this as "South Texas voters are conservative." But the reality is that they are not giving people like Michelle — and all of the South Texas voters that chose her as their Democratic nominee — a fair shot. The status quo isn't working and voters here recognize that. Michelle is the breath of fresh air that energizes them and makes them believe that a better future is possible. Hello Friend,Have you been watching what is going on in our world? Do you need help to encourage you in your faith and fortify your hope in these dark days?When anxiety over inflation, wars, and uncertainty strikes, you need hope immediately. That's why God has given you His Word. He doesn't want you to have to wait for the peace that comes from knowing He's in control of the future.God's Word says that he knows how the end will happen.. Jesus rules victoriously over evil, and you'll spend an eternity in glory - free from pain and suffering - in His presence. That is such good news!While we wait for that ending, perhaps you or someone you love might have questions about what is happening now in our world and how it fits in with what God says is coming. Those are legitimate questions, and God's Word has answers!I've written a book that outlines the end of your story. That ending is powerful and perfect. You won't be disappointed, and believe me, you won't want to change a thing. The name of my book is _Perfect Ending: Why Your Eternal Future Matters Today_.This book will help you face your tomorrows, not in fear, but in absolute confidence, to prepare you for the soon and certain return of Christ. As you read, you'll:
---
* Gain valuable insight into how future biblical events affect you in the here and now.
* Find the answers to the 10 most frequently asked questions about heaven.
* Discover how some of our government's policies are paving the way for the Antichrist.
* Come to understand the crucial, but often confusing and overwhelming subject of Bible prophecy.
* Understand the precise sequence and importance of prophetic events like the rapture, tribulation, and millennium.

---

name: Attorney Larry Klayman
subject: BREAKING: January 6 Peaceful Protesters BEG to get moved to Guantanamo Bay
body:
They’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment! No
They’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment! No Mass or Sunday worship service. Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of ripe urine. Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells! | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlao8u4au8hgafdeo4eq89dg7an5p72nhklcs040_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs)
---
| | |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn3idldcnns73ld3rv935j8ff3vuifkrtkph4id0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs) Hi Patriot,

[Please give a crucial $10, $25, $50, $100, or more IMMEDIATELY to fully fund my two critical, class action lawsuits and hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS!](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5cn6smss1h9j1617mdrcq816pkqn3i3f4biaa08_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs)

I just read the urgent letter signed by 34 innocent Americans, jailed in Washington, D.C for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 presidential election.

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Their letter reads like an appeal from dissidents in the Soviet Union.

Here are just a few examples of what they’re enduring (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy through a 4-inch by 10-inch window of cold metal doors
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of ripe urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without a shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

Outrageously, there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water and keep them from attending court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for up to a year and a half...in AMERICA.

**They conclude their letter by pleading to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where the Taliban, al-Qaeda, and ISIS terrorists get better treatment!**

This can’t go on. I won’t allow it.

I’m Larry Klayman, the founder ofstrong Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows. I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.

I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $10, $25, $50, $100, or even more. If you’ve given before, please give again. If you can, give more than you’ve ever given to Freedom Watch.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2vm7cds61vkfe2b9ovgl096brcgmeoksji61llg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs)

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can now.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, I’m heartbroken after reading that powerful letter from our fellow patriots who are rotting in jail in Washington, D.C. **These are innocent men and women, tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $5, $10, $25, $50, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Each dollar counts.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpco41l0poa2g6ci5pcc1v118vnretagtch7mltg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs)

**Free the January 6 Protestors!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping innocent Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their wives and children...and kept from seeing their lawyers and clergy!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

And another protester, a patriot grandma with cancer, just finished serving 60 days in federal prison for a crime she didn’t commit.

[But there’s something you can do about it ...you can donate immediately to Freedom Watch’s critically important lawsuit to HELP FREE the rest of these persecuted patriots with your crucial gift today.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl2cm416ehtg3ahav43pdu002ia0oac361k7hnvo_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs)

Hi team, this is Mark's twin brother, Scott. I want you to remember this number:
**_375**_
That's the number of aircraft carrier landings Mark completed (on seven different ships).
A naval aviator contends with the ocean, the weather, and the aircraft carrier — not to mention their own plane. Landing on the flight deck is one of the most challenging things a person can do. | | | A new investigation revealed that the Trump Organization charged Secret Service agents outrageous rates to stay in Trump hotels while protecting the Trump family. [_Sign the petition: Demand Trump refund the taxpayers for overcharging the government to stay in his hotels! >>_](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tca54572a-fb51-4f9e-93ea-a71d53264392/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | A bombshell report from the New York Times shows that Trump properties have been overcharging the Secret Service – and lying about it for years! In 2019, Eric Trump said the Trump Organization charged the government only “like $50” for hotel rooms during presidential visits. Instead, records obtained by the committee showed, the Trump International Hotel in Washington repeatedly charged the Secret Service rates more than $600 per night. In one case, the hotel charged the Secret Service $1,160 a night for a room used while protecting Eric Trump in 2017. That was more than four times higher than the government’s usual spending limit for Washington hotels. This is absurd – the taxpayers have been unknowingly lining Trump’s pockets! Trump should have to return all of the extra funds he charged the government for staying in his hotels. [If you agree, sign now to tell Trump: I demand a refund! >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T78bde698-0709-436b-9901-0338e3361d9e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Team Diehl-Allen
subject: Geoff and Leah Announce a "Take Freedom Back" Tour Across MA
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Diehl for Massachusetts
body:
| | | |
---
| Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen announced today that their campaign will host a "Take Freedom Back Tour" across Massachusetts over the next few days.
"This tour will give people across our state an opportunity to hear the pro-freedom message of our campaign loud and clear, directly from us, right in their home town," Diehl said. "Our campaign is built on grassroots support, and we are taking our message straight to the people of our state."
According to Diehl, the Take Freedom Back Tour will travel through central and eastern Massachusetts on Saturday, October 22 and Sunday, October 23, culminating with a rally hosted by Jeff Kuhner at Boston's Faneuil Hall on Tuesday, October 25.
In addition to Diehl and Allen, their campaign has invited all other Republican statewide candidates to join the tour, and is in the process of extending invitations to Republican elected officials and regional candidates who wish to join along. "We are here to unite people in the name of freedom," Diehl said.

body:
There's been too much money, too many special interests, and too little accountability in our government.
Peter,

Earlier this year, I was honored to have been recognized as a champion of campaign finance reform and restoring accountability in our government by the **_End Citizens United Action Fund._**

**Now, I am extremely proud to announce that I 've received their endorsement! **

Look: _People are justifiably frustrated by how broken our politics are._

Over a decade ago, the Supreme Court made the monumental _Citizens United_ decision. Since then, there's been too much money, too many special interests, and too little accountability in our government - and things have only gotten worse. As a result, we've seen our political system suffer damaging blows, and the role of big money in politics escalate to new extremes.

Peter, since day one in Congress - I've been working to reduce the role of money in politics, fix the broken political system, and get Congress back on track. I'm proud of this endorsement from the nation's leading organization working to ensure a federal government that works for the people.

Peter, President Obama just gave a great interview on the “Pod Save America” podcast. I encourage you all to listen to the full podcast [here](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/Mqag7sW8TIW-nixyBdulQgW8CoaT7x-d_6RbuknKN2LiS1q7Znvu2T4emrcP9U0mm7lls3fDavzXfvw-GB61iahhl-T7yKYJ-BS8HLOAtL6gsU6ExnBw1Qkfq8dqHZpb-ziEdB-O1RFHSEzx6l_Pk3oopWsYdCrEH8q9Veo-xzELD2N4SgmKMZU_Ck327i4k274nrxjjDifD2PqbZ-0WSTD51jCWxacFRsIz9ZZZ6S2dYlmXp5rfvoxWxsHBWJFOASseLs-pw-PTftah0XCigF5bOIkM9vJGCmOA3pCGkFU/3qe/_aalidudQe-xsiSQj9o6OA/h0/adMh-I6pfmsKm99sBgo3V74iF8WKnWKmUflNcw3v_Fs), but one quote from Obama really stood out to me. **** Obama said that “the thing I worry most about during these midterms, and this happened throughout my presidency and pretty much every Democratic presidency, is that we, our democratic voters get real hyped up around presidential races, and we lose interest a lot of times during midterms.”

I encourage you all to listen to the full podcast , but one quote from Obama really stood out to me. **** Obama said that “the thing I worry most about during these midterms, and this happened throughout my presidency and pretty much every Democratic presidency, is that we, our democratic voters get real hyped up around presidential races, and we lose interest a lot of times during midterms.” | I completely agree with President Obama. name: Connor Boyack
subject: Debunking 40 popular political and economic myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv33mvuipg1lbkrqqg4g443340k8oj9gnt1vdiug_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi66o34clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv1s54eu62bjieo1fgqr4mhsukm1dm3sgq4v7vkg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi66o34clh2bs)**
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmsn9p5020e81gh96c0t0oi88lqc53l906tdg7gg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi66o34clh2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl2c7v5gb45bo5glij1nbrter1ct3d3hlo3gs5to_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi66o34clh2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zh6ot3mv7ild40d5ks4jlh88foga1rr6i29bfkf0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi66o34clh2bs)**_ today!
Thank you,

Connor Boyack
Author, Tuttle Twins
Founder, Libertas Institute

Team,
Thanks to a recent special election victory in Alaska, Democrats have a small 5-seat margin in Congress right now. **_Which means every battleground Congressional seat matters._**
We told you recently about our efforts to help boost Get Out The Vote efforts for 10 major Senate battlegrounds. Thanks to our grassroots team stepping up, we’re able to dip our toe in some major House races now as well.
While there are only 10 real battlegrounds for the Senate, the House has dozens and dozens of seats in play. With a narrow majority, anything could get them to turn red or blue.
**[Team, can you donate $10 today to help us fund our crucial GOTV efforts in critical House races?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52858675/373612797/-1376232640?refcode=EM_FR_221018HouseWorkResend_N_ML_90DO_9_N_TESTA_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYTk5ZmQ5Yi0xODRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CeshLHuTIBd3TFozOIMmiljnjW4MVYd32jlw6aJqobU=)**
[DONATE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52858676/373612798/-1376232640?refcode=EM_FR_221018HouseWorkResend_N_ML_90DO_9_N_TESTA_B1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYTk5ZmQ5Yi0xODRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CeshLHuTIBd3TFozOIMmiljnjW4MVYd32jlw6aJqobU=)
We've tested several programs centered around reminding voters of their polling location and, for those in all-mail ballot states, what their ballot looks like since both have changed in many cases since the 2020 elections.
It turns out, when you text someone a picture of what their mail-in ballot envelope looks like, there’s a greater chance they fill it out and mail it in! When you text people the address and photo of their polling location, they go vote!
This may seem obvious, but no one was doing it before we tested it. Now, we know it works, and we want to use it to boost Democratic turnout in critical toss-up races.
Thankfully, many battleground House races overlap in the top 10 Senate campaigns – but we need to be able to directly target in House races, and we need to expand outside of the Senate battleground states.
**[Team, this could be the difference between holding Congress and losing it. Will you donate $10 today to help us scale this GOTV program? | | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zq6kmre748b86p1nqhjfn0anejstc0273i8m3pq0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6clh2bs)**

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

Dear Friend,
Today marks three weeks out from Election Day. I know I’ve said it before, but I’ll say it again — the momentum is on our side. 21 days is not much, but it’s all the time we need to build up this coalition of Tennesseans who are tired of the lack of leadership in this state and ready for real change.
In these final 21 days, we have to show up and let our voices be heard. Early voting starts tomorrow, and it’s so important that we not only remind ourselves to find time but also encourage our friends and family to get out and exercise their right to vote. I promise that, as governor, I will return the favor by being a voice for every Tennessean, regardless of whether someone voted for me.
In 21 days, Tennessee will decide whether it wants to continue down this path of absent leadership and policies that work to the detriment of the majority of Tennesseans, or if it’s time to elect someone who will always work for the people of this state. That’s the kind of governor that I will be, but I can’t get there without your support.

Friend,

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Entrepreneurship : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate. Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. Your voices should be heard

Folks,
Last night, candidates for Ohio’s U.S. Senate seat faced off in their second debate – but still, Mike DeWine is refusing to debate Nan on the issues.
Now, he’s going one step further, refusing joint editorial board meetings and even basic interview requests. One thing is clear: He’s terrified to face voters and defend his record for Ohioans.
So we’re taking the fight to him, because Ohioans deserve the chance to hear from their candidates before casting ballots – and we want to know what you’re most interested in hearing about.
**[Take a minute right now and let us know: What questions would you have for an Ohio gubernatorial debate?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52835551/373574637/-2047802686?refcode=nw_em_221018_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjQyZjZjZi0wMjRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4Rd828ktlEVE-zHu3i4fMwJw7F8YyDwoV4HOLSVUjT8=&emci=7665ea93-004f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=a642f6cf-024f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=24357242)**
There’s a lot at stake in this election. Reproductive freedom, action on gun violence prevention, enacting policies that help working families thrive, tackling the corruption in Columbus – all this and more is on the ballot.
With so much on the line, it’s critical that voters have the chance to hear directly from the candidates. But Governor DeWine is content to hide behind his shield of dark-money ads rather than face up to his record of corruption and failure.
We won’t stop asking Mike DeWine to answer for his record, because with time running out, he shouldn’t get to run away.

name: Maggie Hassan
subject: Just wrapped up my first debate
body:
Derek,
I just wrapped up my first debate, and the differences between myself and my far-right opponent, Don Bolduc, couldn't be more clear.
Before I go any further, can I ask you to split an urgent grassroots donation between my campaign and CommonGood' s to help us defeat my anti-choice opponent? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221018_CGVA_Hassan]
Throughout my time in office, I have tried to follow the example of the people of New Hampshire, who put aside their differences to get the job done. I'll always work across party lines to deliver on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters.
Meanwhile, Don Bolduc spent his time on his biggest platform yet doubling down on his extreme positions and misleading Granite Staters.
If Don Bolduc had his way in the U.S. Senate, he would end Medicare and Social Security as we know it, defund the Department of Homeland Security, threaten the integrity of our free and fairly administered elections, and take away a woman's most fundamental freedom.
We must hold him accountable so the voters of New Hampshire know just how extreme he really is.
But that takes resources.
I know I've asked a lot of you, Derek. But today's debate made it clear just how high the stakes are for this race.
That's why we set a post-debate goal to reach 400,000 online donations. Every donation will help us show the strength of this grassroots campaign and ensure that we have the resources to beat Don Bolduc.
So please, if you can, split $25 or more between CommonGood and me to help us win this tough fight and protect our razor-thin Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221018_CGVA_Hassan]

name: NextGen America
subject: Student debt relief is finally here
body:
| | Friend, **Did you see the news? The Biden administration’s Department of Education has officially launched the online application to apply for up to $20,000 in student debt relief.** Over the last weekend alone, more than 8 million Americans applied via the beta version of the application. You have until December 31, 2023 to submit your application. **It only takes a minute to complete and no supporting documents or your Federal Student Aid (FSA) ID are required.** To qualify, individual borrowers must make less than $125,000 a year. Families who make $250,000 a year are also eligible. If you received a Pell Grant, you may qualify for up to $20,000 in loan relief. If not, you may qualify for up to $10,000 in student debt relief. [Take a minute to officially apply for up to $20,000 in student debt relief.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52862417/373630135/1050619006?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNDA4MmEwNy0yNTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7JVqK5Nx6uM3AApPNFd08boWShhXTZwZH_qlMTNNtZM=&emci=85c39336-234f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=c4082a07-254f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172) President Biden’s decision on student debt relief will eliminate federal student loan debt for roughly a third of borrowers. Without the burden of student debt, many Americans will finally be able to start building the lives they’ve envisioned. **This historic moment couldn’t have happened without organizers and activists like yourself.** You shared your stories, signed petitions, and showed up online and on the ground to hold President Biden to his promise of canceling federal student loan debt. **The actions of President Biden and Democrats show us that they’re listening — and delivering results. ** [Submit your application to receive up to $20,000 in student debt relief. It only takes a minute!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52862418/373630143/1050619006?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNDA4MmEwNy0yNTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7JVqK5Nx6uM3AApPNFd08boWShhXTZwZH_qlMTNNtZM=&emci=85c39336-234f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=c4082a07-254f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172) Together, we’ve proved that young people have the power to create transformative change and improve the lives of millions of people — and we’re just getting started.
