clean_body: | | Friend, Did you see the news? The Biden administration’s Department of Education has officially launched the online application to apply for up to $20,000 in student debt relief. Over the last weekend alone, more than 8 million Americans applied via the beta version of the application. You have until December 31, 2023 to submit your application. It only takes a minute to complete and no supporting documents or your Federal Student Aid (FSA) ID are required. To qualify, individual borrowers must make less than $125,000 a year. Families who make $250,000 a year are also eligible. If you received a Pell Grant, you may qualify for up to $20,000 in loan relief. If not, you may qualify for up to $10,000 in student debt relief. President Biden’s decision on student debt relief will eliminate federal student loan debt for roughly a third of borrowers. Without the burden of student debt, many Americans will finally be able to start building the lives they’ve envisioned. This historic moment couldn’t have happened without organizers and activists like yourself. You shared your stories, signed petitions, and showed up online and on the ground to hold President Biden to his promise of canceling federal student loan debt. The actions of President Biden and Democrats show us that they’re listening — and delivering results. Together, we’ve proved that young people have the power to create transformative change and improve the lives of millions of people — and we’re just getting started. Thank you, NextGen America P.S. Already applied yourself? Hillary Clinton herself just attacked me on Twitter! **Now the phony January 6th Committee is trying to frame me again with Adam Schiff and Jamie Raskin insisting I will be charged for January 6th related crimes,_despite any evidence of actual wrongdoing ... and Hillary Clinton is egging them on._** **Hillary would like us all to forget that she refused to accept defeat by Donald Trump in 2016 and tried to stop the Electoral College certification of his election.** **In fact, I did not go to the President Trump 's speech on the Ellipse on January 6th, did not march to the Capitol and was not at the Capitol. _There is no evidence whatsoever that I knew in advance about, was involved in or condoned any illegal act on January 6th._** **In Thursday 's televised January 6th Committee meeting they falsely accused me of being involved in the illegal actions at the Capitol on January 6th! They provided no proof or evidence but insisted they would refer the matter to the Justice Department for prosecution.** **I 've been down this road before.... After watching their big hearing, I realized they had _no real evidence against me_ , other than "guilt by association." This whole thing is just as phony as the Russian Collusion hoax and the fabricated charges they brought against me last time.** When I woke up on the early morning of January 25, 2019, to 29 heavily armed FBI agents storming my home pointing high-powered rifles at my wife and me and arresting me for the fabricated crime of "lying to Congress" to hide non-existent collusion between the Trump campaign and "the Russians." Thanks to you and your help this politically motivated attempt to destroy me was derailed. The leftwing Democrats and their media allies are still bitter about my pardon and now they have a new plan afoot to frame me. **The fact that I attribute President Trump 's pardon to my redemption in Jesus Christ and my fervent prayers to Him to deliver me from my persecutors drives my enemies even crazier!** But I am not going to cower down in the face of their assaults, which is why I need your help again. It's bad enough that my wife and I are fighting ELEVEN totally baseless civil lawsuits filed against me by crackpots, left wing lunatics and George Soros based front groups. We already have $40,000 in past due legal bills! _**We will not give up this fight, because we know that thousands of patriots like you are on our side and have our backs.**_ I cannot go to a grocery store, drug store, restaurant, or God forbid an airport, without being physically assaulted by crazy woke leftists. Last week a man spit on me in an airport in Spokane, Washington and threatened to kill me. Neither TSA nor the local police would lift a finger! _Now it 's not only time to defend myself but it's time to fight back, but I cannot do it without your help. Let me explain...._ Based on this phony January 6th hearing Thursday, MSNBC has accused me of insurrection, murder, conspiracy, obstruction of Congress, money laundering, fake elections, felony murder, fundraising fraud, and witness tampering. _**Because there is no evidence of my involvement in any of these crimes, I want to sue MSNBC for $25 million!**_ We lost our home, my car, our savings, most of our insurance and my ability to make a living. Now I want to get some of that money back. **Won 't you please send me an emergency contribution to the STONE LEGAL DEFENSE FUND BY [CLICKING HERE](https://102671.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=ym6zmxawdm6v5aldn7&linkid=0&link=a1c7bf93223b4554b8fed315126c6c4d) NOW?** You have been so generous to us I hate to ask again for your help but now _I must not only defend myself against these new fake charges, but it is finally time to fight back._ I can't do it without your help. Please send a contribution to this important fight today by going here to [DONATE](https://102671.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=ym6zmxawdm6v5aldn7&linkid=1&link=7b3d438f717a4eb7b9635056cca569cb). **God Bless You!** Roger Stone **PS- I am also happy to tell you that thanks to the healing power of Jesus Christ my wife Nydia who was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer right after my pardon has now been tested cancer-free for 18 months!** **PPS- If you prefer not to put your credit card information on-line you can make a check payable to "Stone Defense Fund" and mail it to 1007 N. Federal Highway, # 405, Fort Lauderdale, Florida 33304.** [https://stonezone.com](https://102671.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=ym6zmxawdm6v5aldn7&linkid=2&link=095c46e250e242f492da67a32e3d9bef)

Donald Trump has officially been subpoenaed by the Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th Attack on the United States Capitol. This is significant news, Friend.
Even as the bipartisan committee's public hearings reveal and highlight Trump's pivotal role in inciting the deadly attack on our Capitol, Trump continues to spew lies about the results of the election - and even praises the attacks as displays of patriotism.
It's long past time for Trump to be held accountable, and that should begin with him appearing before Congress - under oath - to answer for his potentially criminal behavior.
But as we've seen time and again since Trump took over the Republican Party, the vast majority of the GOP - including my opponent in this U.S. Senate race - will do whatever they can to shield and exalt Trump by obstructing and discrediting any investigation into the former President.
That's why it's incumbent on movements like ours to demonstrate the overwhelming grassroots energy demanding our nation holds Trump accountable. I need 250 members of this team to speak out before my 11:59 p.m. deadline, and I haven't seen your name yet - so please respond:

Dick

name: Candace Owens
subject: White Lives Matter
body:
Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing “White Lives Matter” shirts.
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8aa18g2ad03ptj1p2j4jimgpo1eq14bvvbrm38g_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

Friend,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5jagk2m3m7n8from0oehsg7edds34ti1m2d9kmg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zse5b9tutpguc2tl73td0nalh8giv7r0q2ogq9vg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Please consider supporting BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $25, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zamt3tav9rr8spvvnmpiijnsngb49ugc0udqgip0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdltsjk7q3r9dlkj8i6i9oapgjdiohc5lh3dt18o_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zurc0ea1jcsrrnvi3fhbmujvnluldhi1dmfo4sko_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2za4scmpq74dq062preeijq34eejtkeugahvjm7eg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zl8q02oau23vdil48i8k80blltikh26robe2fg28_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z94oq43nuk8log1knjtle74kvg02ls4mr0jlqhno_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8fslstb2n4nrfvagoeq3399r90c0c0d6ovqa6r0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhp4ubla3v1fr2miojlqi0ffgtn8uiqq7ke6d9bo_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgfee9d5q2tmii1l7hkk1csn9utf0069m1ejuiv8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhm5ucd44vng8b28l7jd6vda1l187hg38a9bn5kg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**" One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity."**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

[_**Your support empowers, awakens, and inspires millions of minorities to pursue the American dream and shape their own futures. Please send your generous gift today and help them find their BLEXIT >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoi94tgpsdanebr6qlkgvmtv06p4o7k1fvugtrk8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

**Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice** : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvlme24hq5e0uqtb0klp3jt5ed58dd4qo511rdf0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z70fpl1s4lt776pbrljs2p7a7tmktpn5u5iuk20o_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ztg1vk2bndl9bg78t5kaarkg6eg6eg0ur7936jn8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zl5tdn3dih4afjm40oqcglq6e91ij3m0gbuic7v0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh9f78lg41manbt9k16gjhaccp6gt0qt79n4dofo_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg3lmduoko74f9kcoq66j6mbgbj4a3ij6jhifiq8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9nlkta4ofqoglfihu4us0ovq2dqvo9gpk9ln7s0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chi62oj6cph2bs)

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities: No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total. Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it. No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders. No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test. The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities. In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above? Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this. " One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity." This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today. It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities. We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is simply not true. BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. Our message is about UNITING people -that means all people \- not division. Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping. Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters. BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Entrepreneurship : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate. Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. I hope you’ll chip in to the DNC today to help defeat MAGA Republicans and elect Democrats nationwide. | | Derek, we’re less than 21 days from the midterms -- and the stakes are crystal clear. It’s about the right to choose. It’s about the right to privacy. It’s about whether Social Security will be paid for or whether it’s going to be something that comes up every year and has to be voted on again. It’s about the safety of kids -- instead of dealing with reading and writing and arithmetic, learning how to duck and cover. It’s about the survival of the planet -- literally, not figuratively. It’s about the right to vote. It’s really about democracy itself. And I don’t think that’s hyperbole. America is at an inflection point: MAGA Republicans are going to take us backward. And we have to choose a different path. If we elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House, Derek, we will codify Roe. That’s why if you’ve been waiting for the best time to make your first donation, now’s your chance. Will you make a $7 donation to the DNC today to elect Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide? We have to stay in the game in a big way. We can’t afford to lose this election. Thanks for being on this team, Derek. It means a whole heck of a lot. Joe Joseph R. body:
Even at a tender age, Trudy had a very specific vision for who she wanted to be: a nurse.
| | |
---
Peter, it's Trudy's husband, John. As Halloween approaches, kids are carving pumpkins, putting up spooky decorations, and, of course, picking out costumes.
In the holiday spirit, I wanted to share this photo of Trudy wearing one of her favorite costumes from her childhood – a nurse’s uniform. **This picture truly holds a special place in my heart because, in short, it shows my wife being her truest self.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52864182/373636879/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk375-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjE5OTRlZS0yOTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t4TtrFYrC2iIHbmdyN8MoNXqXZm9GF7stVIIhp7U9OU=)
As a dad, I can tell you that no kid chooses a costume lightly. Whether it's a Halloween costume or just another game of playing pretend, picking out a costume is an incredibly important, deliberate decision. They are telling their parents and their friends what they care about and who they want to be. While a lot of kids choose the latest superhero or Disney character (both excellent choices, make no mistake), **even at a tender age, Trudy had a very specific vision for who she wanted to be: a nurse.**
At her core, Trudy has always been someone with a desire to heal and care for others. What started as a costume and games of play pretend became volunteering as a candy striper, then attending nursing school, serving her community as a nurse, becoming a children’s advocate, and finally caring for families as a hospice volunteer. **Every day I have known her, I have seen her continue to lead with a nurse's caring heart – to extend compassion and kindness to everyone she meets, to listen carefully, especially to those whose voices are rarely heard, and to work diligently toward people-centered solutions.**
As Missouri's next senator, that is exactly the type of leader that she will be in Washington. But just like a nurse, she can't do this alone – and she would never claim to!**To overcome the attacks against her campaign and win this election, Trudy needs this team to stand with her.**
**[Please, with this election just a couple of weeks away, can I count on you to chip in $5 to power Trudy's campaign? Together, we can send a nurse's mind and heart to the Senate, heal the divides facing our country, and win a bright future for our kids.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52864184/373636881/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk375-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjE5OTRlZS0yOTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t4TtrFYrC2iIHbmdyN8MoNXqXZm9GF7stVIIhp7U9OU=)**

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: John Grisham
subject: Please give me a moment to explain why your support of Cheri Beasley is so important
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Cheri would provide one of the most important and impactful voices in Washington.
#

Hey there,
It’s John Grisham, reaching out on behalf of the woman I hope we will elect as North Carolina’s next Senator: Cheri Beasley. Can you give me a moment to explain why her race is so important and what her leadership in the Senate would mean for our families?
I spend a lot of time thinking and writing about justice in this country — and how often it is out of reach for working people, particularly in poor communities and communities of color.
Today, stories like mine are a lot harder to come by. I was born and raised in the deep south. We didn’t have much. My parents didn’t have a formal education, but they worked hard to make sure we had enough and gave us every opportunity they could to thrive.
Too many families struggle to get ahead, and for a lot of folks, the opportunities I got were always out of reach. The status quo has always been and remains tilted in favor of the wealthy and well-connected, and it’s no accident.
Cheri Beasley understands that it’s time to level the playing field for working families, and that’s what she will do as North Carolina’s next Senator. But first, she needs our help to win this race.
[**Will you please donate anything you can to her campaign today? Corporate special interests are spending over $34 million attacking her to buy this seat, and we need to make sure they cannot drown her out with dark money.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221018-2-MA&t=1&akid=2050%2E357359%2E2A3TQu)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221018-2-MA&t=2&akid=2050%2E357359%2E2A3TQu)**
North Carolina and Cheri’s campaign are personally important to me. My wife was born in Raleigh, and my family is full of Tar Heels. I know that this state deserves a leader like Cheri representing them in the U.S. Senate, and for all of us, flipping this seat is one of our best chances to move the needle toward justice in this country.
Cheri would provide one of the most important and impactful voices in Washington. She is undeniably qualified with her wealth of experience as a public defender, judge, and Chief Justice of North Carolina’s Supreme Court. She will also bring an important perspective to the Senate Chamber that currently has zero African American women serving.
I know we can trust her to stand up to the special interests that thrive off of Washington gridlock and corruption.
But we cannot expect our broken system to fix itself. We have to fight for it. So I am asking:
[**Please consider making a contribution to Cheri’s campaign today to win North Carolina. Early voting starts in two days, and it’s going to take a lot of us chipping in what we can to take on the corrupt interests trying to buy this seat.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221018-2-MA&t=3&akid=2050%2E357359%2E2A3TQu)

The status quo has always been and remains tilted in favor of the wealthy and well-connected, and it’s no accident. Cheri Beasley understands that it’s time to level the playing field for working families, and that’s what she will do as North Carolina’s next Senator. But first, she needs our help to win this race. North Carolina and Cheri’s campaign are personally important to me. My wife was born in Raleigh, and my family is full of Tar Heels. I know that this state deserves a leader like Cheri representing them in the U.S. Senate, and for all of us, flipping this seat is one of our best chances to move the needle toward justice in this country. Cheri would provide one of the most important and impactful voices in Washington. She is undeniably qualified with her wealth of experience as a public defender, judge, and Chief Justice of North Carolina’s Supreme Court. She will also bring an important perspective to the Senate Chamber that currently has zero African American women serving. I know we can trust her to stand up to the special interests that thrive off of Washington gridlock and corruption. But we cannot expect our broken system to fix itself. We have to fight for it. So I am asking: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly: | | ** | | | | | | | Thank you for standing with Cheri Beasley and helping us bend the arc toward justice. Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take.

Friends –

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with almost $60 million in attack ads. With just 21 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.

subject: the longest email I’ll send you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tim Ryan for Ohio
body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=6159%2E3611125%2ECzv9jl ][IMG]

This is the longest email I’ll ever send you, so I hope you’ll read the
whole thing.

I want to share our game plan for flipping Ohio’s open Senate seat
blue—when you’re running in a swing state that Trump won, you can’t leave
anything to chance.

That’s why I have to ask: [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/27247?t=1009&amount=25&akid=6159%2E3611125%2ECzv9jl ]Will you make a $25 donation to help us on
the road to victory to flip Ohio blue and expand our Democratic Senate
majority?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/27247?t=1010&amount=25&akid=6159%2E3611125%2ECzv9jl ]Chip in

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step One: Talk to Folks in Every Corner of Ohio

Working class Ohioans, in our big cities and our small towns, know what
it’s like to be left out and left behind. I won’t be that kind of Senator.

We kicked off this campaign by launching a Workers First Tour. Since then,
we’ve been traveling all over Ohio—visiting union halls, factories,
restaurants, and even a few bars—to hear from folks about the challenges
they’re facing.

The truth is, a lot of people don’t trust politicians, and they have every
reason to be skeptical. The only way to break through that is to look
someone in the eye, shake their hand, and let them see that you don’t have
eight heads.

The opposition might be spending millions of dollars to attack me, but
your donations allow me to do what matters—show up and meet folks
face-to-face.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step Two: Stand Up to Special Interests and Put Workers First

I’ve made more than a few headlines for getting loud (okay, outright
yelling) on the House floor, because when it comes to speaking up for the
hardworking people out there busting their rear ends every day, I’ll never
hold my tongue.

Whether it’s the Chinese government, Big Pharma, a corporate giant trying
to ship jobs overseas, or a member of my own party—I’m not afraid to take
on anyone who tries to leave our workers high and dry.

If that puts a target on my back, so be it.

My Republican opponent JD Vance can rely on the steady support of dark
money groups, but I’m proud to run a campaign that’s powered by grassroots
supporters like you—not right-wing special interests and tech
billionaires.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step Three: Focus On The Issues That Matter

The vast majority of Americans are working harder and longer, making less,
and falling further behind. CEOs are getting golden parachutes, while our
seniors are cutting pills in half because they can’t afford their
medications.

You wouldn’t know it from listening to JD Vance though—all he does is yell
about the culture war du jour. We’re not going to flip Ohio blue and
expand our Democratic majority by starting fights over Big Bird and Dr.
Seuss—we need to stay focused on the issues that matter.

It doesn’t matter if I’m talking to a Democrat, Independent, or
Republican—I’m talking about jobs and wages. I’m talking about making Ohio
a manufacturing powerhouse. Lowering the cost of prescription drugs.
Expanding broadband access. Making sure our kids get a good education.

Vance is trying to make this race about anger, division, and fear because
he knows that when it comes down to the issues that actually make a
difference for working families, he’ll lose every time.

That’s why my team has to send you emails like this one—so we’ll have the
resources to get our message out over all his GOP nonsense.

I’m giving this race everything I’ve got, but I can’t win this thing
alone. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/27247?t=1011&amount=25&akid=6159%2E3611125%2ECzv9jl ]I’m personally asking you to rush a donation of $25 so we can
carry out our campaign strategy, flip Ohio blue, and finally cut workers
in on the deal.

Tim

| | | Friend, I just wrapped up my first debate, and the differences between myself and my far-right opponent, Don Bolduc, couldn't be more clear.

**[_Before I go any further, can I ask you to split an urgent grassroots donation between my campaign and the DSCC to help us defeat my anti-choice opponent and defend the Senate?_](https://go.dscc.org/go/4728?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20221018-MaggieHassan-HassanFirstDebateTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20221018-MaggieHassan-HassanFirstDebateTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=7796%2E9716520%2Es_5uxP)**

Throughout my time in office, I have tried to follow the example of the people of New Hampshire, who put aside their differences to get the job done. I'll always work across party lines to deliver on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters.

**Meanwhile, Don Bolduc spent his time on his biggest platform yet doubling down on his extreme positions and misleading Granite Staters.**

If Don Bolduc had his way in the U.S. Senate, he would end Medicare and Social Security as we know it, defund the Department of Homeland Security, threaten the integrity of our free and fairly administered elections, and take away a woman's most fundamental freedom.

We must hold him accountable so the voters of New Hampshire know just how extreme he really is.

But that takes resources.

I know we've asked a lot of you, team. **But today's debate made it clear just how high the stakes are for this race and our Democratic majority.**

That's why we set a post-debate goal to raise $100,000. Every donation will help us show the strength of this grassroots campaign and ensure that we have the resources to beat Don Bolduc and defend the Senate.

But today's debate made it clear just how high the stakes are for this race and our Democratic majority. That's why we set a post-debate goal to raise $100,000. Every donation will help us show the strength of this grassroots campaign and ensure that we have the resources to beat Don Bolduc and defend the Senate. Friend – I gave it all I had on the debate stage. **Now, early voting has begun in Arizona, which means that our window to reach the voters we need is closing. **
I’m gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.

This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking – even for me.

It feels like another super PAC or dark money group is announcing another million dollar TV ad every couple days. And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate, we’ve got to be able to set the record straight.
**Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It’s a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.**
I know I’ve asked a lot, friend. But I really need your help, and the ball’s in your court now. This seat is at risk, and if we don’t hold onto it, we’re very likely to lose the Senate. So, how about it:

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Where I know we could be doing better
body:
I need to make sure that we maximize the momentum we have. | | |
---
| | Dear friend, I feel really good about where we are in this campaign. At 100,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those who will decide the outcome of this election. Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters – especially young voters – with the messages that give them a reason to care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers. And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, six major mass shootings on his watch, or the outright banning of reproductive health care freedom in Texas, he’s given Texas voters – Republicans as well as Democrats – plenty of reasons to vote for change. The polls are starting to show it as well. A new one has us within just four points – and within the margin of error – of Abbott. **The only place where I know we could be doing better is fundraising.** **** While we’ve kept pace with Abbott on a day to day basis, matching his corporate donors with grassroots support, we started this race more than $50 million behind. I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win. [As we continue organizing everywhere, I hope that you’ll consider splitting a donation between our campaign and the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee. I need to make sure that we maximize the momentum we have, the progress we’re making and this extraordinary chance before us to win here in Texas and in state legislatures across the country. ](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xBExroZjznZ1mlyTYEvuD9D3Oz2WTRrZ2EgEypA6WUSusaNGl_EeIelihEq3UeMaGsdKcv56Ylov5huCB1eoZwR1TzSjYCLP7LX_bZz_WGhe2WxeTgqqkzI0iVmt2r_NfARoWBxvIxQ6pqHBO7QzlcnoslRYlQN1cA7cbYSr1eQYt__k-01YxDHef3JGvkLjdqRd4ZCOqsenlwV9EMbbFpS61IC-8-Oig1SZJm8ZNjNAIs_9pOSXtNrNNfjCaxMMTjtUCpAq41i5rdUhCxMz2pBMsANbbvA04eD8zHlDxkvDR7KnYmJkTYmyaIaemsXDTlSsTH-xXZdY9TFA2qy9jA3MybAe00dtzXLq6DOvtq_EGOw-U3UiwZp-tBRlEdnm7YuvDwNwYcW4kQCcv4bVLe/3qe/ZRIPR3-bTmqMeHfCYt5oWA/h0/joDaLGJVVKdIxlIQ2bEQtkbzXziZq5YkyEn0WNEBoQg) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately and be split between Beto O'Rourke and the DLCC.

clean_body: I need to make sure that we maximize the momentum we have. | | | | | Dear friend, I feel really good about where we are in this campaign. At 100,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those who will decide the outcome of this election. Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters – especially young voters – with the messages that give them a reason to care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers. And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, six major mass shootings on his watch, or the outright banning of reproductive health care freedom in Texas, he’s given Texas voters – Republicans as well as Democrats – plenty of reasons to vote for change. The polls are starting to show it as well. A new one has us within just four points – and within the margin of error – of Abbott. The only place where I know we could be doing better is fundraising. **** While we’ve kept pace with Abbott on a day to day basis, matching his corporate donors with grassroots support, we started this race more than $50 million behind. As you know, I'm a proud Illinoisan, and my family has deep roots in rural America. Like many of you, I grew up in a family that felt extremely sidelined by the political process. I got into campaigning to do just the opposite, and to make people who grew up in small towns just like mine feel listened to by their representatives. Now, I'm the president of United Rural Democrats, where we're taking that plan and amplifying it across rural America. How are we doing it – with help from people like you, Peter. And now, because I know you're such an avid United Rural Democrats supporter, I wanted to share our plan before Election Day with you. | | Dear D. P., Our "We are Better Together" rally was a huge success with over 400 people in attendance! We honored Hispanic Heritage and we recognized the first ever Community Advocate of the Year Award to Enrique Henry Grace. Enrique formed the Charleston Hispanic Association five years ago and is the President of the First Latin Exchange Club in the Nation. He has a heart of gold in supporting the Hispanic Community working tirelessly and motivating others to do more everyday. We are so grateful for his support and we are excited about the future. There were many activities for adults and children including the Team Martial Arts/American Taekwondo Association demo and the Mujeres Latinas dance, and we gave away six kids bikes, a gas grill and food for the community provided by the CHA.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
| | | [](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=ce32893e39&e=fdefed58de)
---
Peter,Texas is known as a GOP stronghold, but Texans know that there are some Congressional seats still controlled by Democrats in this beautiful, red stateMy name is Irene Armendariz-Jackson and I'm writing to you today because no matter where you live in this great nation, it is imperative that you are part of our mission to take back the House. I'm running in Texas's 16th District, but this a nationwide race. Most emails you receive from candidates don't actually tell you anything, but I’m going to be transparent:.**We need funds to win this race. I'm going to provide you with seven reasons that contributing to our race matters and is a worthy investment:**(1) Our district is 81% Hispanic. With the latest polling, the GOP is absolutely dominating with Hispanic voters. No matter what they say about the voter registration in our district, a Hispanic Republican like myself can absolutely win here -- especially one who is bilingual and the daughter of legal Mexican immigrants.(2) My husband was a Border Patrol agent for over 25 years. I understand firsthand the fear of sending my husband to work everyday on such a risky border. I know what it's like to send my husband to be on the border with the cartels. I also know what the true conditions are on the border, not the lies the media shows. Our border crisis is far worse than anyone knows... and I WILL STOP IT!(3) I am staunchly pro-life. I will never back down from that. My pro-life stance is what spurred me to run for elected office in the first place. I will never back down or give a safe haven to elected officials who want to fund Planned Parenthood or do away with the Hyde Amendment.(4) This isn't my first rodeo. I've run for political office before. I learned the ropes and know the mistakes not to make. It's very hard running as a first-time candidate and winning. I have a great team of people around me and have a strategy to win - now I just have to implement it.(5) I actually live in my district. While so many people go into communities they have no connection with and then cannot win, I have lived in El Paso for a huge part of my life. I know the people here and I know what this community truly is. We don't want to be Ellis Island like our current representative says. We want to remain El Paso.(6) I am not Veronica Escobar. Veronica is one of the most radical members of Congress. She'd be a Squad member of the Squad would accept her, but apparently they think she isn't hip enough for it. Veronica's voting record matches up with AOC's about 95% of the time. Beto O'Rourke handpicked her for this seat, as he was the last occupant before her.(7) I will never stop fighting. I know that sounds cliché, but when I tell you that the issues at the border are not just a talking point, but my actual home... I mean it. I do not want my daughters to be raped by illegals. I do not want the cartels in my backyard. I will put my life on the line defending this community because this community is my home.
| [SUPPORT US TODAY WITH A DONATION!](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=dda55fc5bc&e=fdefed58de)
---
There you have it, friend. I've already won my primary and we are now fundraising for the general election. We're going to need a **SERIOUS** amount of cash to secure this victory in November, but every poll says that we can do it.If you want to help us get to victory, simply click below and donate. Our final FEC deadline is tomorrow, October 19th. I don't want to fall behind where we should be.**I need your support and I need it today. Whether it's $20 or $2,000 it goes an incredibly long way. Every state in the union needs to help us because as you know, the every state is now a border state.****Stand with me today and let's go onwards to victory!**

body:
Friday's debate between Tim Michels and Tony proved how much is at stake
on Election Day.

While Tony outlined his plans to build a better Wisconsin for everyone and
make even more progress on what we've already accomplished, his radical
opponent attacked democracy, abortion rights, and public school funding.

Heck, he even found the time to insult Wisconsinites as "lazy."

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1733?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20221018_2_2&t=1001&akid=5491%2E1827488%2E5tltvh ]Tim Michels is sinking millions into this race from his own family
fortune in order to fund a barrage of attack ads against Tony, and time is
running out for us to respond. Can Tony count on you to pitch in to help
him close his $75,321 media budget gap so he can get his next round of ads
on the air before Friday's deadline?

— Begin Forwarded Message —

Derek,

At Friday's debate, Tim Michels proved how out-of-touch he is by calling
our fellow Wisconsinites "lazy."

Michels' dismissive view of the very people he’s running to represent was
shocking but ultimately not surprising from a man who’s planning to end
free and fair elections and take away a woman's right to control her
healthcare decisions.

Tim Michels thinks he and his wealthy friends know what's best for the
rest of us, and he's using his family fortune to flood the airwaves with

Make sure you are registered to vote and plan how you will vote in this election. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = The organizing team is working tirelessly with our partners, Power the Polls, to safeguard election integrity by ensuring polling places across the nation are fully staffed. I’m sure you’ve heard that far-right election deniers and conservative extremists are stopping at nothing to obstruct our democratic processes, from enacting voter suppression laws to intimidating election officials. How can you claim to love this country but actively undermine the very bedrock of our democracy? If you’re thinking about the answer and unsure how this is possible -- you’re not alone. Over the years, we’ve mobilized across the country, fighting for fair maps, holding elected officials accountable, and advocating for people to have the opportunity to have their voices heard at the ballot box. = Our democracy may be on life support, but I believe that together, our work can revive it -- not just for a better tomorrow but also for future generations. body:
Peter,
Well, it's getting real. Tomorrow, October 19th is the final FEC deadline of this election!
20 days until the election, final FEC report, TV ads up and voters are voting!
Camille and our campaign team have done a really smart job using our campaign funds wisely - a massive grassroots organizing program, early investments in latino organizing, TV and digital ads, even billboards. We've also had a few budget surprises including vandalized signs and Republicans spending against us incredibly early. Through it all, you had our back.

name: R. Warnock
subject: I need you now more than ever
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
Friend, quickly following up to make sure you saw my email.
---
Yesterday, thousands of Georgians went to the polls to cast their early ballots, which means the election is officially underway and **the clock is ticking to reach as many voters across the state as we can between now and Election Day.**
There are so many folks who still haven't heard our people-powered message, but it takes a lot of funds to keep our TV ads on the air, distribute campaign mailers, and knock on as many doors as possible. That's why your grassroots support matters now more than ever.
Friend, with Senate control on the line, every dollar you give today will go directly toward reaching voters in the next three weeks. **[So please, can I count on you to give $5 or more before tomorrow's FEC deadline to help keep both Georgia and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52861646/373627158/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4487-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmIzOWQ4OC0yMTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AJyKrU2rb4PA73B2fCGy1TflntlIhLKCh2FYkINvg_U=)**
Thank you. I can't tell you how much your support means to me.

– Rev. Warnock
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Raphael Warnock**
Date: Mon, Oct 17, 2022
Subject: an exciting day in Georgia
| | |
---
I know you've been getting a lot of emails, friend, but I couldn't help but reach out on such an exciting day here in Georgia: **The polls are officially open for the first day of in-person early voting!**
We've come a long way since we started this journey together, and we're finally in the home stretch. As folks across the state cast some of the first ballots of this race – the race that _FiveThirtyEight_ says will decide Senate control – I'm as fired up as ever.
I know we're going to win, but that doesn't mean I don't need your help in these final weeks. You see, polling still shows Herschel Walker and me neck and neck, and the GOP just poured over _$30 million_ into Walker's campaign to help him take the lead and defeat us.

# [Over-budget $12/2 million City Hall renovation: Not the right time or use of your money.](https://theresacoatesellis.com/2022/10/18/over-budget-12-2-million-city-hall-renovation-not-the-right-time-or-use-of-your-money/)
| | theresacoatesellis Oct 18
---|---
With supply chain issues, record-breaking inflation, and spending out of control, now is the time to re-examine spending and Capital Improvement Plans in our City of Manassas and to vote the Democrats out. Our City Hall renovation on a 35 year office building is $5 million over-budget because of the economy. Labor was also over-budget because the trades are in-demand.
Read more: [Sticker shock continues: Manassas to dip into rainy day funds to pay for office building renovation (potomaclocal.com)](https://www.potomaclocal.com/2022/10/12/sticker-shock-continues-manassas-to-dip-into-rainy-day-funds-to-pay-for-office-building-renovation/)
Our residents were hit by Democrat majority YES votes (4-2) to send outrageous tax bills for personal property and real estate. The personal property that includes vehicles -- cars and trucks -- used daily for work and life, crippled almost everyone -- an very unfair tax.
The YES Votes (Ayes) to INCREASE YOUR car/truck (personal property tax bills) were the Democrats. Seconded and put to vote by Ralph Smith, Democrat. The NO Votes (Nayes) AGAINST your high tax bills were Republicans. Please vote for Ellis, Greene and add Bookwalter to balance this Council. The tax bills are outrageous.
While real estate tax bills are also outrageous, it impacts only real estate owners that can trickle down to renters -- but personal property impacts almost everyone who drives today.
With the real estate market shifting and building projected to slow -- wait. Lynn Forkell Greene and I voted NO on this new budget, the increases in personal property tax for your trucks, cars, and vehicles, and NO to the tax bill increases on your real estate.
Please note that a 98 bed brand new hotel with 4 floors in Manassas City was projected to cost Tru by Hilton $13.95 million and a projected local **tax revenue benefit** of nearly $370,000 during the first full year of operation. The grand opening was the Fall of 2020. I researched construction costs: [To show the contrast in building costs and with government and private buildings, Jacksonville is building a Tru by Hilton with 98 beds for $6 million and was permitted in 2021 with **45,147** **square** **feet.**](https://www.jacksonville.com/restricted/?return=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jacksonville.com%2Fstory%2Fbusiness%2Freal-estate%2F2021%2F09%2F19%2Ftru-hilton-receives-city-permit-build-new-hotel-jacksonville%2F8319696002%2F) Our City Hall -- an office building -- with about 35,000 sq. feet is $12.2 milllion. I argued to rebid and seek contractors local and who do not just build government buildings -- high bids. Democrats voted against this -- so your tax money is being wasted -- once again.
[Groundbreaking held for Tru by Hilton Hotel in Manassas (potomaclocal.com)](https://www.potomaclocal.com/2019/07/09/groundbreaking-held-for-tru-by-hilton-hotel-in-manassas/?fbclid=IwAR0gaMX49v5KgrIY-aNiWal3R7YomJFUHw-Bum3bqI4PYmm0qzNUWNsjN6g)
City Hall is an office building -- not a special use building like a public safety, fire station, or a school.
I asked for modification for a more efficient customer care option only. Democrats were against this as well.
Please get out to vote to balance a lopsided City Council. We fight for you and with Theresa Coates Ellis and Lynn Forkell Greene re-elected and adding Rick Bookwalter -- we will have a fair and balanced Council to stop these outrageous spending that are hitting our residents hard.
Research your candidates -- we are job-ready with the experience that matters to be your City Council members.

\- Bryan Cranston

Dominic Rapini, Election Reform Leader

** Don’t Miss Tonight’s Debate!
------------------------------------------------------------

Tonight, I will face off against my Democratic opponent, Stephanie Thomas at 8 p.m. for our first formal debate. The debate will be live across allCT Public platforms (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=1dbe6d2c0c&e=8763c56857) , including PBS and NPR.

There will be a Debate Watch Party at West Haven RTC Headquarters—315 Morgan Lane, West Haven, CT, 1st Floor. Food and beverages will be served. My heartfelt thanks to the West Haven RTC for their assistance with this event.

Right now, there are 4 federal fraud investigations going on. In a separate case, last month there was a conviction. Yet at the press conference the Democrats hosted a few weeks ago on elections—no press member asked my opponent about the investigations and she has yet to acknowledge them. Rather, she is too focused on spreading lies and misinformation about my campaign.

I hope tonight we will concentrate on and acknowledge the issues before us. As many of you know, since the beginning of my campaign, my message has been about restoring integrity in our elections. That starts with recognizing that there are problems. But, if elected your next Secretary of the State, I know that I have the knowledge and experience to fix them and make our elections some of the best in the country.

I hope you will tune in—whether at home or by joining my team at the Watch Party.

Thank you and Godspeed,

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

------------------------------------------------------------

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** October 18, 2022**CONTACT:** Gabriella Shanahan, [gabriella@scottgryder.com](mailto:gabriella@scottgryder.com)
---
**Kendall County Board Chairman Scott R. Gryder Signs Resolution Criticizing the SAFE-T Act**
---
**Oswego, Ill**. – Local law, national implications. The Safety, Accountability, Fairness and Equity-Today Act, known as the SAFE-T Act has raised concerns among 100 State’s Attorneys and a growing number of local and state officials.

Several initiatives of the SAFE-T act go into effect over the next few years. Most notably, beginning January 1, 2023, the elimination of cash bail is set to take effect. This severely limits the judiciary’s ability to set bail to hold the accused accountable, and it puts victims and their families in jeopardy of safety and security. When we let criminals free, our nation suffers. Under the SAFE-T Act, they will be free to travel and escape to their next crime without being held accountable with bail.

Radical politicians continue to unilaterally decide what is best for you and your family. They continue to pass bills without your input, without your voiced concerns, without the concerns of attorneys and law enforcement. Lauren Underwood refuses to acknowledge and condemn the SAFE-T act. Instead, she continues to campaign and accept money from radical, defund-the-police politicians.

I stand, and will continue to stand, with law enforcement, first responders, and victims and their families. Every individual has the right to feel safe and secure in their home and community. I will speak against and hold the line on bad legislation like I’ve done with this resolution.
One question that remains to be answered: where do you stand on the SAFE-T act, Lauren?

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

It’s Lauren Groh-Wargo, Stacey Abrams’ campaign manager.

Last night, Stacey took the debate stage and made it clear why she’s the
best choice for Georgia. She called out Brian Kemp’s lies, showed the
world that his radical far-right agenda doesn’t work for Georgia and
shared a powerful vision for One Georgia.

But we’re going to need all hands on deck to defeat this good ol’ boy.
Because as the architect of modern-day voter suppression, Kemp’s allies
will stop at nothing to suppress votes in the first weeks of Early Vote.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221018_B4_PostDebate_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=13705%2E1862389%2EcLMqNR ]From education and housing to health care and a good living, Stacey has
a plan for One Georgia, where everyone has a chance to thrive. But she
needs your help to mobilize hundreds of thousands of voters in the first
days of early in-person voting. So, will you invest $5 — or
whatever you can — in our campaign so we can overcome Brian Kemp’s tactics
and win this race?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221018_B4_PostDebate_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=13705%2E1862389%2EcLMqNR ]DONATE

business owners, young voters, and Black and brown people. Dodging
questions about his extreme, dangerous gun bill, his failure to keep
hospitals open and more — he showed us he has zero solutions, no real
record and no real plans for the people of Georgia.

This debate marks a pivotal point for us in this campaign,
Derek.

Yesterday was the first day of Early Vote, and Brian Kemp’s voter
suppression tactics have already made appearances all across Georgia.

So we need to turn out as many voters as possible to overcome those
hurdles and help Stacey build One Georgia.

Derek. Will you donate
$5 so we can defeat Brian Kemp? With your investment, we
can meet Georgians where they are, help overcome Brian Kemp’s voter
suppression and win this election.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221018_B4_PostDebate_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=13705%2E1862389%2EcLMqNR ]DONATE

— Lauren Groh-Wargo

clean_body: We need a people-powered DNC to secure our majorities next month. | | Derek, because of the work of this grassroots team in 2020, the American people delivered a Democratic Congress and sent Joe Biden and me to the White House. And over these last few years, Democrats have delivered in big ways. But we have only 21 days left until Election Day to continue defending our progress. We need to keep it up ahead of tomorrow’s FEC filing deadline. If we can rise up to support our party ahead of tomorrow’s deadline, we can build on the progress we’ve already made and then some. Can I count on you to make your first donation of the year ahead of the DNC’s FEC deadline? Because grassroots donors supported the DNC in 2020, our party has been able to provide emergency relief to the American people, pass legislation to lower drug prices, pass the most significant gun violence prevention law in 30 years, and make the largest investment in our history to combat the climate crisis and deliver on environmental justice for people everywhere. We have done all of this and brought down the deficit by a record amount. We have paid for all of this without raising taxes on working people. We have done a lot, but we still have a lot more work that we’re ready to do. That is exactly why we need you. We need a people-powered DNC to secure our majorities next month and elect more Democrats at all levels. I’m so grateful to know I can count on you in these final 21 days. body:
Our democracy is on the ballot.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52869403/373655480/-1711679463?refcode=EM_FR_221018ElectionDeniers_N_CAUCUS_30DO_6_NG_TESTA_logo&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjQwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNmQ4ZWI1OC0zOTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4ezjLj4Ren8_vgOdHIlF4VYy5TBZh67mjLoA3Oj4Bpc=) Election Day is a lot closer than you think, Peter.

With early voting underway, and polls closing in just under 3 weeks, it’s now or never if we’re going to defeat the GOP’s extreme election-denying agenda and save our democracy.

We already saw the danger election sabotage posed on January 6, but the danger has only become greater now that a majority of the GOP has adopted that rhetoric. **This November, 60% of voters across the country will have an election denier on the ballot, and here in Georgia, we have 19 election-denying candidates running for office, the 7th highest of any state.** There’s too much at risk this November, and we have to fight back to save our democracy. But we need your support, Peter.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu]
With only three weeks to go until Election Day, Lizzie and the team have been covering a lot of ground in the district.
Lizzie and team joined the rally at Memorial Trail Ice House for a beautiful evening with State Representative Ann Johnson, candidates for Texas Land Commissioner Jay Kleberg, and Texas Comptroller Janet Dudding.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu]
Lizzie was excited to join the Asian American Democrats of Texas for an AAPI GOTV Rally in Houston’s Asiatown to get Texans fired up to vote in the consequential races happening up and down the ballot.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu]
Later that day, Lizzie was recognized on the stage at the International Diwali Dussehra Festival at Constellation Field in Sugar Land, joining the many thousands in attendance celebrating the festival of lights at the largest Diwali festival around.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu]
And that was just Saturday! She’s been at meet-and-greets, including one hosted by the South Asian Bar Association and Asian American Bar Association, as well as rallies, roundtables, receptions, and more. It’s all critical to getting out the vote, and making sure people across our community know the stakes in this year’s election.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221018wu?refcode=lpfe221018wu]
Early voting begins in Texas next Monday, October 24!
Visit VoteTexas.gov and learn more about early voting and make sure you and all the Texans you know have a plan to cast your ballots. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/early-voting.html]
There are only three weekends left before Election Day, so you know #TeamLizzie will be spending them GOTVing! If you’re looking for a way to help — and we hope you can! — join us for one of these upcoming volunteer opportunities:
We’re teaming up with Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo’s team for a phone bank tomorrow, October 19, from 6 to 8 p.m. Help us make calls to Harris County voters to make sure they have plans to vote! [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/527311/]
We have another postcard-writing party this Thursday, October 20, from 6 to 8 p.m. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/486971/]
And our next Day of Action is this Saturday, October 22! County Judge KP George and Candidate for State Rep. Dr. Suleman Lalani (HD-76) will join us in Fort Bend as we meet voters where they are and work to get them to the polls. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/524791/]
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/524791/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/524791/]
Join us for any or all of these!
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

Friend, I just wrapped up my first debate, and the differences between myself and my far-right opponent, Don Bolduc, couldn't be more clear.
**[Before I go any further, can I ask you to make an urgent grassroots donation to help us defeat my anti-choice opponent?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52870719/373660293/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1868-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDk0ZDdkZC0zZTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AauWt-IgSOG5-As9gs3mnUfuhrd3d2qaduaO2kqtOAw=)**
Throughout my time in office, I have tried to follow the example of the people of New Hampshire, who put aside their differences to get the job done. I'll always work across party lines to deliver on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters.

**Meanwhile, Don Bolduc spent his time on his biggest platform yet doubling down on his extreme positions and misleading Granite Staters.**
If Don Bolduc had his way in the U.S. Senate, he would end Medicare and Social Security as we know it, defund the Department of Homeland Security, threaten the integrity of our free and fairly administered elections, and take away a woman's most fundamental freedom.

We must hold him accountable so the voters of New Hampshire know just how extreme he really is.

But that takes resources.
